recommendations: If GEPA remains an anchor, explain MIPROv2 and TextGrad in one mechanism clause each: MIPROv2 jointly selects instructions and bootstrapped demonstrations with surrogate-guided search; TextGrad propagates natural-language feedback through a computation graph. This clarifies GEPA's trace reflection and Pareto selection without adding performance claims.
Keep GRPO beside GEPA as the weight-update comparator and describe its group-relative, critic-free advantage estimation.
Correct the graph: SIA does not cite SEAL; the continual-internalization seed does not cite SEAL; the reward-free world-knowledge seed does not use Voyager as its highlighted predecessor.
For SHAPER, use SkillOpt as a direct related-work predecessor with a fixed harness. Do not call it a tested SHAPER baseline. EmbodiSkill and AutoHarness supply the skill-only and harness-only axes.

Prioritize direct tested comparators for empirical anchors: ACE and Training-Free GRPO for AHE; AWM, Dynamic Cheatsheet, Evo-Memory, ACE, and XSkill for Evo-Harness; EnvScaler, Agent World Model, ScaleEnv, and Simulator for Agent-World.

High-priority register omissions are MIPROv2, TextGrad, Dynamic Cheatsheet, XSkill, EnvScaler, Agent World Model, Learning by Distilling Context, On-Policy Context Distillation, and Meta-Harness. Screen them before promoting citation context to evidence about efficacy.
limits: Fourteen of fourteen seeds were inspected from exact reviewed versions available by the 2026-09-16 cutoff; 60 edges were selected by contribution role, not quota.

Eight seeds were read from retained PDFs and six from temporary official arXiv PDFs. Every seed has a coordinator-checkable text path under /tmp/jc-learning-verification-20260916; temporary files remain outside the repository.
Edges verify how seed authors use a work. Except for bounded primary mechanism checks of MIPROv2, TextGrad, and GRPO, they do not verify cited findings.
